name: AI Engineer 5 - Developer Tooling & Agents
job_description:
About the Role

An engineer to build the tooling the rest of the group uses. The work is applied rather than research, and you will be judged on other people's throughput.

What We Are Looking For

  • 3+ years on applied AI systems

  • Developer tooling that people used voluntarily

This post is remote anywhere in the United States and we expect no office attendance. The range for this role is $265,000.00 - $415,000.00.

You must be authorised to work in the United States for the duration of this role, and we do not sponsor a visa for it.
